generator: Turbopack's task statistics (NEXT_TURBOPACK_TASK_STATISTICS=<file>) with bench/turbopack-gym/tools/task-exec-stats.patch applied on top of each binding's patches: per function it adds executions (a task of the function started executing) and invalidating cell updates (a cell of the function's task changed and invalidated tasks reading it, with their count). A measurement patch, not a candidate
app: drift-monolith; warm: the unedited app's cold build output restored, then one feature module edited to add a new import
note: counts, not timings: the counts of one build vary between runs (a task read while an input is stale runs again), so each warm variant ran twice; the warm builds after one new import with 64, 64 + 66 and 64 + 66 + 67 all produced output 48287ee731786356
